bug_info.bug_desc: The SFENCE.VMA instruction legality check incorrectly allows execution when Supervisor mode (RVS) is not supported. The condition `((CVA6Cfg.RVS && priv_lvl_i == riscv::PRIV_LVL_S) || ((!CVA6Cfg.RVS && !CVA6Cfg.RVU) || priv_lvl_i == riscv::PRIV_LVL_M))` evaluates to true when RVS is disabled and RVU is disabled (e.g., CV32A60X configuration), making SFENCE.VMA legal even though it is a supervisor-level instruction that should be illegal without S-mode support.
bug_info.fix_hint: Modify the SFENCE.VMA legality condition to require Supervisor mode support (CVA6Cfg.RVS) as a prerequisite. The instruction should only be legal when RVS is enabled and the current privilege level is S-mode or M-mode, with rd == 0. Otherwise, it should be decoded as an illegal instruction.
